prompts.technicians: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite atlas for ORDRE DE CENDRE, original 2D side-scrolling industrial science-fiction game. Create exactly EIGHT isolated sprites of the SAME adult civilian hydraulic technician, in a landscape 2:1 sheet with a strict equal 4 columns by 2 rows grid, no visible grid lines. True transparent alpha background; no ground, no cast shadows, no scenic glow. All poses strict level side view facing RIGHT, consistent scale, full figure and generous clear margins. Row 1 left to right: relaxed standing idle; walking contact pose with right boot forward; walking passing pose with one knee forward; walking opposite contact pose with left boot forward. Row 2 left to right: walking opposite passing pose; standing and operating a waist-height hand tool with both hands extending slightly forward, NO separate machine; compact protective crouch with both feet low; lying still on side on ground level, non-graphic, no wound or blood. Civilian waterworks technician from maritime planet Nacre, worn ochre sand-yellow hard hat, dark petrol-teal overalls, faded ochre waterproof utility vest, old cream reflective bands, work gloves, small toolbelt, rubber safety boots. Warm medium-brown skin, practical adult face, no helmet visor or armor, no weapon. Painterly semi-realistic production game art with fine weathered fabric detail, matte surfaces, sharply readable silhouette, restrained cream/ochre/petrol-teal palette, soft diffuse top-left light, human proportions. Same costume and identity in every cell. Keep limbs and boots wholly inside each cell, separated by at least 32 transparent pixels. The crouched and lying figures are smaller in height naturally, not rescaled. No words, numbers, logos, symbols, blood, weapons, floor, border or painted checkerboard. Transparent pixels everywhere outside each figure.
prompts.staff: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite atlas for ORDRE DE CENDRE, original 2D side-scrolling maritime science-fiction game. Exactly TWELVE isolated full-body human sprite poses, landscape 4:3 sheet with a strict grid of FOUR columns and THREE rows, each cell equal, generous transparent margins, true transparent alpha background, no visible grid or border. FIRST SIX cells in reading order show the SAME adult female ambulance DRIVER in six poses: idle standing; walking right-boot contact; walking passing; walking left-boot contact; walking opposite passing; lying still on her side, non-graphic. LAST SIX cells in reading order show the SAME adult male MEDIC in these same six poses. Thus row 1 is four driver poses, row 2 is last two driver poses then first two medic poses, row 3 is last four medic poses. Every upright figure strict flat side view facing RIGHT, identical human scale, feet level and no perspective change, no cropping. Driver has short dark hair, petrol-teal work jacket with old cream shoulder panels, dark practical trousers, boots, a utility belt with radio, no hat. Medic has short slightly graying hair, dark brown skin, worn off-white/sage medical overshirt with petrol-teal sleeves, dark trousers and boots, small medical satchel. His only emblem is an original small pale mint OPEN RING around TWO HORIZONTAL RAILS, never a cross. Both are civilian port medical workers in a salt-weathered world, sensible covered clothing, no weapons or armor. All faces, clothes and equipment consistent within each six-cell role group. Painterly semi-realistic game assets, fine brushwork and matte textiles, readable shapes at small scale, diffuse top-left lighting, restrained sage/cream/teal palette. Lying poses retain full-body scale naturally and must fit horizontally inside their cell with room. No text, numbers, captions, red cross, watermark, scenic background, ground, glow, smoke or shadow. Real PNG alpha transparency outside silhouettes, not a checkerboard image.
prompts.patients: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite atlas for ORDRE DE CENDRE, original 2D side-scrolling maritime science-fiction game. Exactly EIGHT isolated medical patient-and-trolley sprites in strict equal TWO columns by FOUR rows grid. Orthographic flat side view, trolley horizontal, all heads at LEFT and feet at RIGHT; same trolley width and scale in all cells; large clear transparent margins. Each row corresponds to one of four existing adult patients. LEFT cell: living resting adult lying on a short wheeled low stretcher trolley, head elevated on small pillow and visible, legs under muted sage blanket, peaceful non-graphic care, no other person. RIGHT cell: same patient and SAME trolley stationary, blanket drawn respectfully up over the head as a non-graphic lost state, no wound or blood. Row 1 light skin dark short hair; row 2 medium brown skin short curly hair; row 3 light skin gray hair; row 4 dark skin close-cropped hair. These are graphical variations only. All wear simple cream care clothes below their blankets. Trolley: low stainless frame, two visible small dark rubber wheels, two short cream side rails, dark petrol-teal mat, no pole, no separate equipment, no text or medical crosses. Detailed painterly semi-realistic industrial science-fiction illustration, matte fabric and weathered metal, diffuse top-left light, cream/sage/teal palette. No person standing alongside, no body duplicates, no props disconnected from trolley, no blood, no violence, no dramatic scene. True transparent PNG alpha everywhere outside each cutout and between the wheel supports. No ground, cast shadow, glow, background, checkerboard drawing, border, labels, words or numbers.
